LogViewer

A log stream: virtualised so a long tail stays fast, follows new lines unless you scroll up (then a pill counts what arrived), and searches with next/previous over every match. With wrapping on, lines take their natural height and the browser skips off-screen ones (content-visibility) instead of the fixed-height window.

Source src/react/data/LogViewer.tsx See it in the gallery

Example

11:02:14.000inforeload3 keys changed
11:04:51.000warnratelim/api/login 30/60s reached
11:05:02.000errorstoreECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.4:6379
11:05:09.000debugstoreretry in 2000 ms
Scroll →
tsx 
import { LogViewer } from "@osqd/ui"; <LogViewer  height={220}  lines={[    { time: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 25, 11, 2, 14), level: "info", source: "reload", message: "3 keys changed" },    { time: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 25, 11, 4, 51), level: "warn", source: "ratelim", message: "/api/login 30/60s reached" },    { time: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 25, 11, 5, 2), level: "error", source: "store", message: "ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.4:6379" },    { time: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 25, 11, 5, 9), level: "debug", source: "store", message: "retry in 2000 ms" },  ]}/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
linesrequired readonly LogLine[] — —
height number 360 Height of the scrolling area in px. Default 360.
lineHeight number — Row height in px when not wrapping. Default 22, or 30 on a touch screen.
defaultFollow boolean true Start following the tail. Default true.
defaultWrap boolean false —
defaultLevels LogLevel[] — Levels shown at first. Default all.
showTime boolean true Show the time column. Default true.
showSource boolean true —
toolbar boolean true Toolbar with search, level chips, wrap, follow and next-error. Default true.
onCopy (line: LogLine, text: string) => void — Called after a line is copied (the copy button on each line).

Also accepts every native <div> attribute, passed through to the root element.
